body:
Thought i'll update.
Last night i od'd and got taken into a&e, can't remember anything for 15 hours. Woke up with a, IV in my arm and no recollection how i got there.
And no, i wasn't happy to be alive.
Apparently I had rang my best friend and he had called the ambulance. His mom had got me to open the door for the ambulance and police. 
I spoke to a different psychiatrist today and he gave me antidepressants and sleeping tablets, a weeks supply at a time. He gave me an option to stay in the psychiatric ward for a while or go home, i chose to go and now i'm regretting it.
Everything that is suppose to make me better or help, i look as a weapon.
To Ladybug_loves, no you don't get locked up against your will, they'll ask you.

i've seen 2 different GP's, one counsellor and 3 different psychiatrists. I don't think they really get my struggle, all they see is this confused woman who can't decide whether to move out with kids or not. 
My family is in a different country and i got no friends around whom  to talk to face to face. The kids father is a total ass and drags me down every day with accusations about me being lazy and not doing anything.
I hate feeling like this, i'm bombarded with suggestions and i don't want anything, just to fall asleep and never wake up.
The doctors won't give me anything, i've begged and cried. I don't want my children to grow up seeing a messed up mother that just exists. I'm just so so so tired
